hypothesis: Positive-background stress harms may be partly detectable from observable positive loaded-prior count bias; test a fixed rejection gate rather than relying on weak-prior CV.
gate: Reject cross-input calibration if any of three supplied prior count totals exceed their own observed count total by more than10%. No fitting or threshold search. Rejection returns baseline exactly.
scope: New seed in adaptively studied artificial mechanisms, moderate drift only, not whole-system blind, complete noise coverage or official OD validation.
